end.summary: Anika practised shared responsibility for a clean, green and safe school, including wiping the board and picking up personal rubbish; this is still not steady and needs checking next time.
end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting wet waste such as banana peels, leftover rice and tea leaves, and dry waste such as chips packets, paper and plastic bottles. Using examples from school bins helped them give some correct categories. They continued to mix up composting plastic and foil with rotting waste; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, sort a few safe household items together and ask which bin they belong in and whether each item can rot.
